facts.text: Doreen Thompson bought the century-old corner bar in 1986.
Has a coin-operated cigarette machine and a jukebox.
Weekly events include bingo on Wednesdays and karaoke on Saturdays.
Merchant inside Reading Terminal Market selling Thai food, fresh Asian herbs and groceries.
Menu includes shrimp pad thai, basil chicken, spring rolls, coconut soup and salmon curry.
Stocks curry pastes and ingredients such as galangal, fish sauce and lime leaves.
Neighborhood craft beer bar in West Philadelphia with an attached bottle shop.
Hosts Quizzo trivia on Sunday nights.
Runs a wine club alongside its beer program.
Opened in late summer 2014 by Stefan Gagliano in the storefront where his father ran San Pietro for 20 years.
Features a custom-built charcuterie bar and a wine list that supports female winemakers.
Sells new and used records ranging from punk to jazz, including some hard-to-find punk titles.
Also stocks DVDs, CDs and VHS tapes.
Opened on April 19, 2018.
Founded by Melissa Walter, who worked as a therapist before opening the brewery.
Signature beer is Love City Lager, made with all-American ingredients.
Second taproom, in the building last occupied by Fat Lady Brewing, which closed at the end of 2025.
Taproom seats about 60, with an upstairs space used mostly for private events.
Sophie's BBQ of Havertown is the food provider.
Neighborhood pub in East Passyunk operating since 2008.
Serves craft beer, cocktails and pub fare such as wings and mac n cheese.
Hosts vinyl DJ sets and Eagles game screenings.
Bowling venue with 24 lanes, plus billiards, shuffleboard and giant Jenga.
Includes a lounge and a bar serving food and drinks.
Its PB and Bacon Burger won the 2013 People's Choice Award at the Philadelphia Burger Brawl.
Serves the Mak Attack burger topped with cheese and macaroni and cheese.
Serves natural casing hot dogs on butter-toasted New England style rolls.
Styled as a punk rock burger bar with old rock posters and vintage signs.
Menu features burgers topped with mac and cheese or peanut butter and jelly.
Japanese-owned grocery owned by Osaka-area native Seiko Dailey.
Has an eat-in counter serving rice bowls, okonomiyaki, yakisoba and curry udon.
Independent bookstore opened in 2013 by owner Cathy Fiebach.
Hosts author events, book groups and story times.
Independent record store selling new and used CDs, vinyl and DVDs.
Hosts performances by local and national acts.
Has its own label, MSM Records, which has released albums by local artists.

name: Making Worlds Bookstore and Social Center

facts.text: Collectively owned and operated bookstore.
Began when West Philadelphia organizers searched for space for the publisher Common Notions.
Features a children's book section and a pay-as-you-wish cafe.
Established in 1996 by Harry Renner IV in a former mill building.
The first batch of beer was tapped on October 17, 1996.
Renner's daughter took over in 2004 and runs it with business partner Mike Rose.
Opened on September 19, 2025, by owner Chivonn Anderson.
Named for Marsha P. Johnson.
Interior includes repurposed bleacher seating from a vintage stadium.
Founded by Pat McCloskey, who bought the Ardmore Cafe in 1934 with partners John and Annie Kane.
Pat's son Joe ran the tavern until retiring in 2010.
The Doherty family and Jimmer McCafferty took over in 2010.
Opened in August 2023 in the former Memphis Taproom space.
From chef Drew DiTomo and partners Colin McFadden, Marty West and Keith Shore.
Named to Bon Appetit's 2024 Best New Restaurants list.
Run by Mill Creek Urban Farm, an educational urban farm founded in 2005.
The Philadelphia Water Department awarded 1.5 acres at 49th and Brown Streets for the farm in August 2005.
Grew out of a youth project at University City High School with the Urban Nutrition Initiative.
Nautical-themed tavern; the Rittenhouse location is the original.
Has 12 draft beers and more than 50 bottled beers.
Has a private event space downstairs and a second location in Logan Square.
Sits at the corner of 21st and Chestnut Streets.
Centers on a large marble-topped bar and a brick oven.
Has a large front patio seating area.
